# awscc_smsvoice_verified_destination_number (Resource)

A destination phone number that has been registered for verification with AWS End User Messaging SMS. A newly created number is in PENDING status; it becomes VERIFIED only after the recipient supplies the one-time code out of band.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_phone_number` (String) The verified destination phone number, in E.164 format.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `created_timestamp` (String) The time when the verified destination phone number was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the verified destination phone number. PENDING means the phone number has not been verified yet; VERIFIED means it is verified and can receive messages.
- `verified_destination_number_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the verified destination phone number.
- `verified_destination_number_id` (String) The unique identifier for the verified destination phone number.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value of the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_smsvoice_verified_destination_number.example
  identity = {
    verified_destination_number_arn = "verified_destination_number_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `verified_destination_number_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the verified destination phone number

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_smsvoice_verified_destination_number.example
  id = "verified_destination_number_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_smsvoice_verified_destination_number.example "verified_destination_number_arn"
```
